releases.summary: QR popup viewport fix, compact QR layout, responsive QR sizing, cleaner QR actions, and safer dialog scrolling.

items.title: QR popup viewport fix
items.description: The QR code dialog now stays within the browser viewport and scrolls internally when content is taller than the screen.

items.title: Compact QR dialog layout
items.description: The QR dialog uses tighter spacing and a smaller card layout so organizers can reach the top, bottom, and close control more reliably.

items.title: Responsive QR sizing
items.description: The QR image now scales down on smaller viewports while remaining large enough for participant scanning.

items.title: QR action grid
items.description: QR actions are grouped into a compact Open, Print, and Handout grid to reduce vertical overflow.

items.title: Safer dialog scrolling
items.description: Shared dialog content now has viewport-aware sizing, improving access to long admin popups beyond the QR flow.

releases.summary: Accessible QR-code joining guidance for peaceful events and community participation.

items.title: Accessible QR joining guide
items.description: The public blog now includes a practical guide for making participant QR-code joining more accessible and reliable at peaceful events.

releases.summary: Event-day runbooks, organiser planning shortcuts, chant runtime estimates, dashboard plan access, and participant help guidance.

items.title: Event-day runbook
items.description: Admins can open a generated event plan covering permits, accessibility, safety, participant joining, admin roles, and live controls.

items.title: Runbook copy and print tools
items.description: The event plan can be copied as a plain-text command sheet or printed for event-day volunteers.

items.title: Editor planning shortcuts
items.description: The event editor now surfaces the event-day plan with chant runtime estimates and readiness actions.

items.title: Dashboard plan access
items.description: Organizers can open an event plan directly from each demonstration card on the admin dashboard.

items.title: Participant help panel
items.description: Participants can open in-session guidance for reconnecting, improving visibility, and following local safety instructions.

releases.summary: Participant handout page, sharing tools, editor handout shortcuts, and participant accessibility display controls.

items.title: Participant handout page
items.description: Admins can open a dedicated printable participant handout with the event title, QR code, fallback link, and joining instructions.

items.title: Handout sharing tools
items.description: The handout page includes copy, native share, print, and open-participant-page actions for faster event-day distribution.

items.title: Editor handout links
items.description: The event editor now links to the full handout page from readiness actions and the QR dialog.

items.title: Participant large text mode
items.description: Participants can enable a persistent large-text display mode from the live screen.

items.title: Participant high contrast mode
items.description: Participants can enable a persistent high-contrast display mode for live chant text and progress bars.

releases.summary: Dashboard onboarding, richer event templates, printable QR handouts, and participant end-state guidance.

items.title: Dashboard quick start
items.description: The admin dashboard now shows a quick-start card that explains the live-event setup flow and opens the create dialog.

items.title: More event title starters
items.description: The create-demonstration dialog now includes more common gathering types such as vigils, prayers, walkouts, and rallies.

items.title: Printable QR handout
items.description: The QR dialog now contains a handout-style block with event title, QR code, participant link, and keep-open instructions.

items.title: QR handout print styles
items.description: Printing from the QR dialog now focuses the printout on the QR handout instead of the surrounding admin interface.

items.title: Participant ended next step
items.description: Participants now see a short next-step message when a demonstration ends.

releases.summary: Participant sharing, QR handout guidance, live next-up context, waiting tips, and blog topic suggestions.

items.title: Share participant link
items.description: Event editors now include a Share Link action that uses native device sharing when available and falls back to copying.

items.title: QR handout checklist
items.description: The QR dialog now includes a short handout checklist so organizers know what to include when printing fallback materials.

items.title: Live next-up context
items.description: The live control summary now shows what comes next for the active chant phase.

items.title: Participant waiting tips
items.description: Participants waiting for an event to begin now see simple guidance for staying ready and recovering if updates stop.

items.title: Blog topic suggestions
items.description: The blog index now links to a GitHub issue form so community members can suggest future guide topics.

releases.summary: Faster participant sharing, clearer readiness actions, starter chants, waiting status, and blog discovery.

items.title: Direct participant link copy
items.description: Event editors now have a header action to copy the participant link without opening the QR dialog.

items.title: Readiness test actions
items.description: The pre-live readiness card now links directly to the participant page and QR instructions.

items.title: Empty event chant starters
items.description: Empty events now show starter chant buttons so organizers can create a first chant faster.

items.title: Participant waiting connection status
items.description: Participants waiting for an event to begin now see whether they are connected or offline.

items.title: Homepage latest guide
items.description: The homepage now promotes the latest community guide so new visitors can discover organizer education content.

releases.summary: Public blog section with the first organizer guide and weekly content workflow.

items.title: Public blog section
items.description: ChantLive now has a public blog index and article pages for community organizing, safety, accessibility, and live-event guidance.

items.title: First organizer guide
items.description: The first blog post gives first-time peaceful demonstration organizers a practical checklist for participation, permits, safety roles, accessibility, and weak-signal planning.

items.title: Blog SEO metadata
items.description: Blog index and post routes now have dedicated metadata, structured data, and sitemap entries.

items.title: Blog navigation
items.description: The homepage navigation and footer now link to the community blog.

items.title: Weekly blog workflow
items.description: A weekly blog automation brief now documents the cadence, content standards, and topic backlog for future posts.

releases.summary: Live-event readiness, accessibility fallback, and participant reliability improvements.

items.title: Pre-live readiness checklist
items.description: Event editors now show a checklist for chants, participant-page testing, backup admins, and timing before going live.

items.title: Live control summary
items.description: Live event controls now summarize the active chant phase, viewer count, and reminder to keep the QR/link visible.

items.title: Accessible QR fallback guidance
items.description: The QR dialog now tells organizers to announce and share the participant link for people who cannot scan a QR code.

items.title: Waiting-screen offline warning
items.description: Participants waiting for a draft event now see a clear warning if their browser is offline.

items.title: Real-crowd landing guidance
items.description: The homepage now explains QR fallback, accessible live prompts, and connection awareness for first-time organizers.

releases.summary: Admin list controls and participant live-status clarity improvements.

items.title: Dashboard sorting
items.description: Organizers can sort demonstrations by newest, oldest, or title so busy event lists are easier to scan.

items.title: Dashboard result count
items.description: The dashboard now shows how many demonstrations match the current search and status filters.

items.title: Admin user search
items.description: Super admins can filter admin users by name, email, or role before reviewing activity and demonstration counts.

items.title: Participant phase guidance
items.description: Participant screens now show whether the leader is speaking or everyone should respond during a live chant.

items.title: Participant offline status
items.description: Participant screens now show an offline warning when the browser loses network connectivity.

releases.summary: Readable demonstration creator labels in the admin dashboard.

items.title: Readable demonstration creators
items.description: Admin demonstration cards now show the creator name and email instead of only a raw user ID.

items.title: Creator search
items.description: Dashboard search can now match demonstration creator names, emails, and user IDs.

releases.summary: Admin dashboard creator visibility improvement.

items.title: Dashboard creator user ID
items.description: Admin demonstration cards now show the creator user ID and dashboard search can match creator IDs.

releases.summary: SEO landing pages, crawlability, social metadata, and structured data improvements.

items.title: For organizers SEO page
items.description: ChantLive now has a public organizer-focused page that explains the QR code live chant workflow for events.

items.title: About ChantLive page
items.description: A new public about page gives civic-tech, accessibility, and community sites a clearer page to link to.

items.title: Public internal links
items.description: The homepage now links to the organizer and about pages so visitors and crawlers can discover them.

items.title: Sitemap and structured data updates
items.description: The sitemap and route-specific JSON-LD now include the new public SEO pages.

items.title: Social preview metadata
items.description: Open Graph and Twitter preview metadata now include image dimensions, alt text, and a corrected social card caption.

releases.summary: Dashboard filtering, QR copy feedback, and participant retry improvements.

items.title: Dashboard search
items.description: Organizers can search demonstrations by title to find the right event faster.

items.title: Dashboard status filters
items.description: Organizers can filter demonstrations by all, live, draft, or ended status before opening an event.

items.title: Filtered empty state
items.description: When dashboard filters return no results, organizers see a clear message and one-click reset action.

items.title: QR link copy feedback
items.description: Admins now get visible and screen-reader-friendly confirmation after copying a participant link.

items.title: Participant retry controls
items.description: Participants can retry loading or failed join attempts without being stuck on a dead-end screen.

releases.summary: Admin user activity and demonstration visibility improvements.

items.title: Admin user metrics
items.description: Super admins can see when each user joined, when they were last active, and how many demonstrations they can manage.

items.title: User activity tracking
items.description: Authenticated admin activity is now recorded so super admins can identify recently active users.

items.title: Safer admin user API
items.description: The admin user list now returns display-safe user summaries instead of raw account rows.

releases.summary: Live-event readiness, QR joining, participant waiting, and trust improvements.

items.title: Chant starter examples
items.description: Organizers can fill the add-chant form from common call-and-response examples instead of starting from a blank dialog.

items.title: Live readiness reminder
items.description: Admins see a pre-live reminder to add chants, test the participant link, and invite backup admins before an event starts.

items.title: QR join instructions
items.description: The QR dialog now gives participants clearer scanning and page-open instructions for crowded live settings.

items.title: Participant waiting guidance
items.description: Participants waiting for a draft demonstration now know to keep the page open because chants will appear automatically.

items.title: Landing page trust cards
items.description: First-time visitors now see clearer privacy, mobile-use, and open-source trust signals before signing up.

releases.summary: Customer-facing onboarding, organiser workflow, participant reliability, and QR sharing improvements.

items.title: Clearer event use cases
items.description: First-time visitors can quickly see that ChantLive supports marches, prayer circles, campus actions, and community gatherings.

items.title: Dashboard status summary
items.description: Organizers can scan total, live, draft, and ended demonstrations before opening an event.

items.title: Quick title starters
items.description: Organizers can start new demonstrations faster with common title prompts in the create dialog.

items.title: Participant connection status
items.description: Participants can see and hear whether live updates are connected or reconnecting.

items.title: QR fallback guidance
items.description: Admins get clear fallback guidance for sharing the participant link when QR scanning is difficult.

releases.summary: Deployment monitoring, QR accessibility, and issue-reporting improvements.

items.title: Health check endpoint
items.description: Deployments and uptime monitors can check /healthz for status, version, uptime, and timestamp.

items.title: Bug report issue template
items.description: Contributors can report reproducible bugs with clear steps, expected behavior, environment, and safety checks.

items.title: QR accessibility checklist
items.description: Organizers have practical guidance for sharing participant QR codes with URL fallbacks and scan testing.

items.title: Release health checks
items.description: The release checklist now includes health endpoint and QR sharing verification steps.

items.title: Health endpoint documentation
items.description: README now documents the /healthz endpoint for uptime and deployment monitoring.

releases.summary: Public release notes workflow and changelog visibility improvements.

items.title: Public changelog page
items.description: Community members can review recent ChantLive releases directly on the website.

items.title: Structured release notes data
items.description: Release notes now have a structured source of truth for website, markdown, and automation output.

items.title: Release note scripts
items.description: Maintainers can add, import, and generate changelog entries from npm scripts.

items.title: Release item issue template
items.description: Feature requests can capture user impact and proposed public changelog wording.

items.title: Release item workflow
items.description: Repository automation can record approved release-note items into the structured changelog.

releases.summary: Security, accessibility, deployment, and release communication improvements.

items.title: Baseline HTTP security headers
items.description: API and page responses now include baseline security headers.

items.title: Reduced motion support
items.description: Animations now respect users who prefer reduced motion.

items.title: Screen reader live chant announcements
items.description: Participant chant updates are announced to assistive technologies.

items.title: Release checklist
items.description: Deployment verification steps and common Replit Git recovery notes are documented.

items.title: Project changelog
items.description: Community members can now review project changes before deploying or contributing.
